one_line: Wall Street faces a $5.7 trillion rout as AI spending doubts mount, while political backlash reshapes data center policies and tech investments.

themes.title: Wall Street grapples with AI rout
themes.text: Wall Street faced a market convulsion with a $5.7 trillion stock value loss since October, while Jefferies warned that the global AI investment cycle may have peaked amid rising financing costs.

stories.headline: Wall Street grapples with $5.7 trillion rout as AI bets unwind
AI investment cycle may have peaked, Jefferies warns

themes.title: Midterms bring backlash for data centers
themes.text: Following midterm election setbacks where voters rejected data centers in local ballot measures, OpenAI updated its policies to end non-disclosure agreements with public officials. Meanwhile, political spending by AI safety and pro-AI super PACs saw mixed results.

stories.headline: After the midterms, things are looking rocky for Elon Musk and data centers
OpenAI changes data center policies after midterm voter pushback
Anthropic-backed PAC Public First spent $63M+ in 2026 midterms
Pro-AI super PAC network Leading the Future falls short in midterms

themes.title: AI models disprove math hypothesis
themes.text: OpenAI and Anthropic models disproved the 27-year-old Exponential Time Hypothesis, and Anthropic detailed a new agent memory architecture featuring a cognitive 'dreaming' process.

stories.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic AI models disprove Exponential Time Hypothesis
Anthropic details agent memory architecture and dreaming capability

themes.title: US chips face security scrutiny
themes.text: The US Commerce Department approved dozens of Chinese firms with ties to trade-restricted entities to handle Nvidia H200 chips, and an intelligence memo claimed a Megaspeed executive was recruited to spy on Nvidia's CEO.

stories.headline: US approved Chinese firms with empty offices to handle Nvidia chips
Megaspeed exec recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, US memo claims
